decisions.decision: Use a dependency-free Node.js module plus JSON state files.
decisions.reason: Transparent, portable, and independent of external services.

decisions.decision: Token metrics are REAL only when actual usage fields are supplied; otherwise ESTIMATED or UNKNOWN.
decisions.reason: The repository cannot observe ChatGPT/OpenAI platform usage by itself.

decisions.decision: Out-of-scope changes are reported, not automatically reverted.
